{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 28 is the 56th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 28th day of Capricorn, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 8, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮28日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 56|Chapter 56]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152076}}.

[[Category:Dates with custom text]]
===Chapter summary===
Arboreus, the settler king, divides the plant world between his sons: Lycos, lord of spores, and Ginkgon, master of megaphylls. From Lycos descend Isolagos with his spore-dividing line, Quill and Sellagine, and Lycopodion, who raised the first scale trees. From Ginkgon’s heir Phyllon come Pteridos, father of ferns and horsetails, and Gymnos, father of trees. Their descendants diversify into quillworts, horsetails, puzzlegrass, whisk ferns, adder’s-tongues, and broad fern dynasties. Arboreus’ legacy establishes the great plant kingdoms that shape forests and prepare the swamps for life’s step onto land.
